items.title: Trace Metal(loid) Bioaccumulation, Dhaka
items.details: Planned and analysed 300+ samples across 34 zones of Dhaka to assess how trace metals and metalloids accumulate in vegetables and the wider food chain. Managed large datasets end-to-end and delivered findings on deadline.

items.title: Fair Urban Transition Phase II, Khulna
items.details: Monitoring and evaluation of urban inequality indicators in Khulna city — designing indicators, collecting data and reporting progress.

items.title: ReWET – Restoring Urban Wetlands
items.details: Data and reporting support for nature-based resilience work focused on restoring Dhaka's urban wetlands.

items.title: Industrial Chemical Contamination
items.summary: Tannery groundwater, PFAS, ionophores, heavy metals.
items.details: Published studies on tannery-area groundwater, PFAS, ionophores and heavy metals — building working knowledge of industrial chemicals, their risks and their regulation.

items.title: Radioactivity in Road Dust & Sediments
items.details: HPGe gamma spectrometry analysis of natural radionuclides in urban road dust and river sediments, with radiological risk assessment.
